latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Reels Video Creator.

- Create short-form reel videos from longer footage using AI-powered cloud processing.
- Supports multiple formats: MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB.
- Automatic backend session setup and token acquisition for easy first-time use.
- Export 1080p MP4 files optimized for Instagram and TikTok, with music, transitions, and text overlays.
- Clear error handling and status updates throughout the video editing and export workflow.
